decisions.rationale: The handoff's '133 clear minScore' was not the binding number — maxPerSource:3 cuts the reachable pool to 42, so the choice is 8 of 42. Lowering the cap to 2 was tried on the same run and rejected: distinct sources stayed 5 either way and it traded a score-17 item for a score-12.

decisions.decision: Search indexes full post bodies, in a separate lazily-fetched file
decisions.rationale: Metadata-only is free but measurably not a search — 9 of 20 plausible terms appear only in bodies. Inlining bodies would triple the homepage, so the index is a build-time endpoint fetched on first focus: homepage +4 KB, the 224 KB index only for someone searching.

decisions.decision: Playwright is not a CI dependency
decisions.rationale: The build-time index gate guards every PR and is mutation-verified. A browser download per run is not worth it for one search box. Named as a trade — revisit if the homepage script grows.

decisions.decision: ADR-001 stays Proposed rather than being decided now
decisions.rationale: The cron has not fired once on its own schedule. One real Monday says more than the reasoning; a decision by omission looks like 'preserved' and behaves like 'discarded', so 'open' is written down.

next_action: Nothing is in flight. Monday 2026-09-07: review the first cron digest against its sources before setting draft:false, then use runs 1-3 to close ADR-001.
